mechanism: exact group homomorphism on the monomial subgroup of U(m) (permutation x powers of i), integer arithmetic, re-synthesis on coupled pairs

rule.name: full_swap_hopping_monomial_fusion
rule.idea: A run of consecutive full-swap hopping gates BS(t,p) with t = pi (mod 2pi) and p a multiple of pi/2 is monomial in the Heisenberg (passive) representation: each such gate sends a_j -> i^e a_k, a_k -> i^e' a_j for integers e,e' mod 4, and products of monomial maps are monomial (permutation sigma times powers of i on each mode, tracked with pure integer arithmetic, never floats or complex numbers). Composing the whole run gives a target (sigma, e). The rule re-synthesizes this exactly as: one BS(-pi,0) transposition per transposition in the cycle decomposition of sigma (each only emitted if the mode pair was actually coupled somewhere in the original run, so routing stays legal), followed by per-mode R(t_k) phase corrections with t_k in {0,-pi/2,pi,pi/2} fixing up any remaining power-of-i mismatch via R's exact Heisenberg action R^+ a R = e^{-it} a. Because passive unitaries are fixed by their action on mode operators and both circuits fix the vacuum, equal (sigma,e) implies exactly equal unitaries on the whole Fock space. The rule declines (returns None) whenever a needed transposition pair in the cycle decomposition was never directly coupled in the source run, so it never fabricates illegal 2-op gates.
